objective: Build and audit the widest economically meaningful daily PIT regime feature library supported by existing authorized inputs, without reading trade outcomes or selecting thresholds.
forbidden_inputs: trade return, P&L, MFE, MAE, holding duration, exit reason, NAV return
unregistered style, value/growth, market-cap, or risk-appetite substitutes
decision_timestamp: completed official close of trade_date at 15:00 Asia/Shanghai
first_applicable_execution: next causally valid session; never the feature-formation bar

universe.denominator: exact frozen date-specific membership intersected with the frozen V1 basic-eligible contract
universe.extended_semantics: CY-029 rows use earliest_safe_use_date, exactly matching the frozen extended replay; official 302132.SZ physical rows map to canonical 300114.SZ before 2025-02-17
basic_eligible: current and previous 120 explicit exchange sessions all pass frozen critical_row_valid
hard_valid, bar_valid, trading_state_valid, corporate_action_valid, market_rule_valid, historical_identity_valid
available_at <= completed close; finite positive close/volume and finite nonnegative amount
universe.validation: daily eligible counts must exactly equal authoritative daily_nav.basic_eligible on all 1,942 target dates

price_coordinate.definition: causally continuous adjusted price index compounded from raw closes; on a visible supported action day prior_close is rebased as (prior_close-cash_per_share)/share_multiplier
price_coordinate.rights: any nonzero/unknown rights participation or blocking action invalidates the affected history and fails closed

features: index_realized_vol10, vol20, vol60 (log-return standard deviation annualized by sqrt(252))
cross_sectional_return1, return5, return20 p10/p50/p90 and p90-p10 spread
cross_sectional_return1, return5, return20 skewness and excess kurtosis

style_relative_strength.interpretation: observed index-spread proxies only; not constituent-reconstructed small/large or growth/value factors

risk_appetite.limit_tolerance: max(0.001 CNY, limit_price*1e-6), matching the registered execution validator

unavailable_families.growth_vs_value: UNAVAILABLE: no exact registered PIT factor/index pair selected
unavailable_families.market_cap_small_vs_large: UNAVAILABLE: no frozen PIT market-cap denominator selected; observed 399102-vs-399006 is only an index-spread proxy
unavailable_families.high_beta_vs_low_beta: DEFERRED: can be derived only after validating a causal rolling-beta implementation and coverage
unavailable_families.sector_cyclical_mapping: UNAVAILABLE: prior audit found no authorized cyclical mapping
